text.title: A Winter Holiday
lines: Last February, we went to the mountains for a week.
Every morning, my brother and I went skiing.
My sister doesn't like skiing, so she went ice skating with Mum.
On the last day, I tried snowboarding. I fell over lots of times, but it was fun!

questions.q: When did they go to the mountains?
What happened when the writer tried snowboarding?
options: They fell over lots of times.
